food_sea.unit: tonnes of fish landed per km² of sea

culture.unit: arts, recreation & hospitality workers per km²

districts.label: City Center
districts.rule: Centre tile of a City View metro (largest-population tile near the city's coordinates).

districts.label: Harbor
districts.rule: Seaport with ≥ 1 million tonnes of annual cargo, or one of the country's 3 busiest ports.

districts.label: Aerodrome
districts.rule: Airport with ≥ 1 million annual passengers, or the country's busiest airport.

districts.label: Campus
districts.rule: ≥ 2,000 research works in 5 years from institutions in the tile (OpenAlex), or STEM workforce location quotient ≥ 1.8 with ≥ 300 people/km².

districts.label: Commercial Hub
districts.rule: Gold yield ≥ 8 and finance + professional-services employment LQ ≥ 1.15.

districts.label: Industrial Zone
districts.rule: Production yield ≥ 5 and manufacturing employment LQ ≥ 1.5, or an export-processing zone / industrial park in the tile.

districts.label: Dam
districts.rule: Hydroelectric capacity ≥ 100 MW in the tile.

districts.label: Power Plant
districts.rule: Thermal, nuclear, wind or solar capacity ≥ 500 MW in the tile.

districts.label: Holy Site
districts.rule: One of the country's most notable religious sites (by Wikipedia language editions), or worship-site density in the top 1% of the country's tiles.

districts.label: Theater Square
districts.rule: UNESCO World Heritage (cultural) site, ≥ 5 museums, or arts/recreation/hospitality LQ ≥ 2 with ≥ 300 people/km².

districts.label: Entertainment Complex
districts.rule: Arts, recreation & hospitality employment LQ ≥ 2.5 (tourism economy).

districts.label: Plantation
districts.rule: Perennial/tree-crop share of agriculture ≥ 30%, Food yield ≥ 3 and ≥ 40% tree + crop cover.

districts.label: Fishery
districts.rule: Sea tile with Food yield ≥ 4 from fish landings.

districts.label: Preserve
districts.rule: ≥ 50% protected area, or a national park with visitor statistics.
